releaseGate.reason: Four of twelve controls have exact local pass evidence. No control is accepted for release or verified against private account settings.

controls.name: Unknown plan or credit balance

evidence.locator: unknown allowance blocks a new billable experiment and explicitly degrades frontline
evidence.claim: A new billable experiment is denied with unresolved allowance and no capacity debit.

evidence.locator: explicit LangSmith trace stops before upload while private allowance is unresolved
evidence.claim: An explicit optional export stops before the external request when the private allowance is unresolved.

evidence.locator: unresolvedAllowanceCount
evidence.claim: Unresolved account allowances remain visible and are not converted to a zero or guessed balance.

passCriteria.given: A potentially billable experiment has allowance status unknown.
passCriteria.when: The action is submitted to admission with an external transport spy.
passCriteria.then: Admission returns ALLOWANCE_UNKNOWN, reserves zero units, and the transport spy records zero calls.

passCriteria.given: The private account balance has not been verified.
passCriteria.when: The release-control and Software Passport registers are checked.
passCriteria.then: The balance remains null or absent and the unresolved state is reported.

controls.remainingGap: The production admission switch is disabled and no exact production workflow is founder-accepted.
manualOrLiveRequirements: Privately verify the applicable account allowance without placing credentials or personal account data in this register.
Bind any future workflow acceptance to the exact register revision and release commit.

controls.name: Two agents request the last available budget simultaneously

evidence.locator: two simultaneous requests cannot both consume the final shared allowance
evidence.claim: Exactly one local caller obtains the final complete action and verification bundle.

evidence.locator: concurrent callers cannot both spend the final action-plus-verification budget
evidence.claim: The staged PostgreSQL transaction locks and reserves the shared bundle atomically.

evidence.locator: PGlite rather than concurrent live Supabase connections
evidence.claim: The current evidence explicitly limits its concurrency claim to local development.

passCriteria.given: One shared pool contains exactly one complete action-plus-verification bundle.
passCriteria.when: Two independent callers with different idempotency keys reserve the bundle concurrently.
passCriteria.then: Exactly one reservation commits, one caller is denied for insufficient capacity, and remaining capacity is zero rather than negative.

passCriteria.given: A reservation transaction cannot write its required audit record.
passCriteria.when: The atomic reservation is attempted.
passCriteria.then: The reservation and every pool debit roll back together.

controls.remainingGap: PGlite does not prove real multi-connection Supabase contention and the staged migration is not applied to a disposable Supabase project.
manualOrLiveRequirements: Run the same race through independent connections on an isolated PostgreSQL or disposable Supabase environment.
Review the exact migration before any production application.

controls.name: Alert threshold reached

evidence.locator: C03: successful accepted work sends one idempotent threshold alert with required evidence
evidence.claim: A verified settlement can claim and deliver exactly one bounded threshold alert containing the verified allowance evidence without representing the alert as a spending stop.

evidence.locator: C03: failed founder delivery is recorded once without a delivery claim or retry loop
evidence.claim: A failed founder delivery is recorded once and cannot become a false delivered receipt or automatic retry loop.

evidence.locator: optional continuity runtime seam
evidence.claim: The local model lifecycle can invoke the bounded continuity runtime only through an injected, disabled-by-default boundary.

passCriteria.given: A verified allowance crosses its configured alert threshold but is not exhausted.
passCriteria.when: An accepted workflow reserves and executes one action.
passCriteria.then: The action may proceed and exactly one idempotent founder alert reports the pool, verified remaining amount, reset evidence, and that spending has not been stopped.

passCriteria.given: Founder alert delivery fails.
passCriteria.when: The alert is attempted.
passCriteria.then: The failure is recorded without a false delivery claim or an unauthorized retry loop.

controls.remainingGap: The local notification and deduplication boundary is tested but remains inactive; no production durable store, notifier or privately verified founder destination is connected.
manualOrLiveRequirements: Approve the exact alert wording and destination privately.
Perform one bounded delivery check on the inactive test path after local fault tests pass.

controls.name: Hard limit reached

evidence.locator: C04: optional exhausted work stops before transport without fallback or provider change
evidence.claim: Verified exhaustion denies optional work before any model transport, paid fallback or provider substitution.

evidence.locator: C04: exhausted Frontline records a static response, alerts once and never dispatches
evidence.claim: The local boundary records non-completion, exposes only the configured static continuity response, alerts once and makes zero model calls.

evidence.locator: C04: storage failure still denies transport and cannot invent an alert delivery
evidence.claim: A continuity storage failure remains closed and cannot invent either completion or founder delivery.

passCriteria.given: The shared allowance is verified exhausted.
passCriteria.when: Optional or experimental work is requested.
passCriteria.then: The work is denied before transport with no paid fallback, provider change, upgrade, or network request.

passCriteria.given: The same exhaustion affects an accepted Frontline workflow.
passCriteria.when: The customer request reaches the application.
passCriteria.then: The application returns the approved static continuity response, records the reason, alerts the founder once, and never claims the requested work completed.

controls.remainingGap: The application boundary is implemented and tested locally but remains inactive; the exact production response, durable adapters, founder destination and private account enforcement are not approved or connected.
manualOrLiveRequirements: Approve the static continuity response before a LINE test.
Confirm privately that no paid fallback or overage path is enabled.

controls.name: Railway wake or restart

evidence.locator: persist before work; duplicate intake preserves first payload and processing occurs once after restart
evidence.claim: A locally restarted worker processes a persisted LINE event once.

evidence.locator: lost completion receipt cannot trigger a duplicate side effect after lease expiry
evidence.claim: A lost completion receipt cannot cause blind duplicate execution.

evidence.locator: railway.recoveryChange.restartTested
evidence.claim: The Railway passport records that a Railway restart has not been tested.

passCriteria.given: A durable event exists before claim, during processing, or after external dispatch.
passCriteria.when: The application process restarts at each fault point.
passCriteria.then: No event or business side effect executes twice, and uncertain completion remains reconciliation-required.

passCriteria.given: The inactive Railway test service is sleeping or restarted.
passCriteria.when: A controlled request wakes it.
passCriteria.then: Readiness and version identify the reviewed revision and the customer receives the approved response without a false delivery claim.

controls.remainingGap: Local durable recovery is tested; Railway wake, cold-start latency, first-response behavior, and loaded resource use are not.
manualOrLiveRequirements: Run one controlled wake and restart on an inactive Railway test service within verified allowance.
Record the exact deployment revision, first response, readiness result, latency, RAM and CPU evidence.

controls.name: Supabase read-only or connection exhaustion

evidence.locator: database failures use bounded fixed classifications
evidence.claim: Read-only, connection exhaustion, timeout, unavailable and generic failures map to fixed bounded codes without exposing provider response text.

evidence.locator: read-only database writes fail closed with a fixed classification and no model work
evidence.claim: A read-only write rejection cannot create a run, dispatch a model or claim completion.

evidence.locator: connection-pool exhaustion cannot become an empty or invented document success
evidence.claim: A PGRST003 document read records a fixed failure, returns the static safe response and cannot produce a completed run.

evidence.locator: timeouts and LINE delivery failures retain useful diagnostics without raw error details
evidence.claim: The durable webhook inbox preserves fixed database_read_only and database_connection_exhausted codes without raw database details.

passCriteria.given: Supabase rejects a write with a read-only database failure.
passCriteria.when: An agent workflow attempts the write.
passCriteria.then: The workflow remains failed or blocked, no row is invented, and no completion or delivery is claimed.

passCriteria.given: Supabase reports connection exhaustion or times out before a confirmed read.
passCriteria.when: The workflow requests business data.
passCriteria.then: The application does not substitute an empty or invented result and returns the approved safe response with a bounded failure classification.

controls.remainingGap: Deterministic application behavior is covered locally, but the customer-facing safe response is hardcoded and has no versioned founder approval evidence. Private live Supabase limits and provider-side exhaustion behavior also remain unverified.
manualOrLiveRequirements: After deterministic fault injection passes, confirm applicable Supabase limits and exhaustion behavior privately.
Use an isolated branch or disposable project for any provider-behavior check.

controls.name: LangSmith disabled or unreachable

evidence.locator: disabled, rejected, and timed-out optional exports preserve the customer result and mandatory audit
evidence.claim: Disabled, rejected and bounded timeout outcomes leave the safe customer result and mandatory audit unchanged without retrying.

evidence.locator: mandatory audit failure blocks a consequential action and skips optional tracing
evidence.claim: A consequential action remains blocked when its mandatory Neurohands audit cannot be preserved, regardless of optional tracing.

evidence.locator: a transport that ignores abort is attempted once and remains uncertain after late completion
evidence.claim: A non-cooperative trace transport is attempted once and remains explicitly uncertain rather than being retried or claimed complete.

passCriteria.given: Optional LangSmith export is disabled, times out, or rejects the request.
passCriteria.when: A safe customer workflow otherwise completes.
passCriteria.then: The customer result and mandatory Neurohands audit are unchanged, optional export stops, and no unbounded retry occurs.

passCriteria.given: A consequential action cannot preserve its mandatory Neurohands audit.
passCriteria.when: The action requests dispatch.
passCriteria.then: The action remains blocked even if optional tracing is available.

controls.remainingGap: The optional export boundary is verified locally but is not wired into a real customer workflow; the private LangSmith allowance, retention and account settings remain unverified.
manualOrLiveRequirements: Privately verify trace allowance, retention and overage settings before any real export.
Keep customer content out of the bounded synthetic trial.

controls.name: Sensitive information in trace input

evidence.locator: the actual outbound transport receives only the bounded redacted trace
evidence.claim: The export boundary redacts credential, signed-link, activation, identity and private-data sentinels before its captured outbound transport.

evidence.locator: the installed LangSmith client sends one redacted HTTP request through a captured offline transport
evidence.claim: The installed LangSmith client receives only a locally captured redacted request and performs exactly one offline transport attempt.

evidence.locator: private document content is denied before transport instead of being relabelled
evidence.claim: Recognized private-document fields and unsafe JavaScript structures are denied before transport rather than being relabelled as synthetic or redacted evidence.

passCriteria.given: A trace candidate contains unique credential, signed-link, activation-code, user-identifier and private-document sentinels.
passCriteria.when: The actual exporter prepares and sends the trace through a captured local transport.
passCriteria.then: No prohibited sentinel appears in the outbound body, headers, metadata, logs, errors or stored trace fixture.

passCriteria.given: Private document text cannot be safely reduced to approved evidence.
passCriteria.when: Trace export is requested.
passCriteria.then: Export is denied rather than relabeling or partially exposing the content.

controls.remainingGap: The local exporter rejects recognized private-document fields and unsafe JavaScript structures, but it does not semantically classify arbitrary private text placed in a generic field. No real customer path or private-data export is approved, connected or release-accepted.
manualOrLiveRequirements: Approve the trace data classes and redaction policy before any real export.
Inspect one captured synthetic trace payload before enabling the bounded trial.

controls.name: Codex proposes deployment without approval

evidence.locator: an exact durable founder claim is audited before one exact commit is deployed
evidence.claim: A founder-approved, exact 40-hex commit snapshot is durably claimed and audited before one injected deployment adapter call.

evidence.locator: missing, wrong, expired, used, conflicting and uncertain approvals make zero deployment calls
evidence.claim: Missing, changed, expired, consumed, conflicting and uncertain approval outcomes remain closed with zero adapter calls.

evidence.locator: a replayed durable claim cannot execute deployment a second time
evidence.claim: A consumed approval cannot be replayed for a second deployment.

passCriteria.given: An engineering or Codex principal lacks founder approval bound to an exact commit.
passCriteria.when: It requests merge or deployment.
passCriteria.then: The external merge and deployment adapters record zero calls and the denial is audited.

passCriteria.given: Founder approval names one exact commit.
passCriteria.when: The commit changes or a second deployment is requested with the consumed approval.
passCriteria.then: The request is denied until a new exact-version approval is recorded.

controls.remainingGap: The exact-commit approval boundary is implemented locally, but its expected Supabase RPC/table, founder approval UI and GitHub/Railway deployment adapters are not implemented or connected.
manualOrLiveRequirements: Privately verify repository and deployment permissions for the release identity.
Require founder review of the exact commit before a controlled inactive-path release.

controls.name: Untrusted code attempts to read a secret

evidence.locator: C10 local evidence: the fixed probe receives no secrets, customer data, real transport or tools
evidence.claim: A fixed adversarial child receives an allowlisted environment, no application tools or transport, and cannot read its synthetic secret file, write artifacts or start child processes.

evidence.locator: C10-PC2: a requested credential is rejected before any child command starts
evidence.claim: Any requested child environment value, including a credential sentinel, is rejected before the adversarial child can start.

evidence.locator: What this does not prove
evidence.claim: The evidence explicitly records that the local VM and Node permission model are not an operating-system or outbound-network isolation boundary.

passCriteria.given: An intentionally malicious untrusted test attempts to enumerate environment variables, secret files and network metadata.
passCriteria.when: It runs in the same isolation intended for untrusted pull-request code.
passCriteria.then: No production credential is present, file and network access are denied, and no secret sentinel reaches output or artifacts.

passCriteria.given: An unnecessary production credential is injected into the untrusted test environment.
passCriteria.when: The release-control test runs.
passCriteria.then: The test fails visibly before any untrusted command is accepted for release.

controls.remainingGap: The fixed local probe has application-layer evidence only. The actual untrusted pull-request environment is not an ephemeral OS-isolated runner with outbound network denied, and Node reports osNetworkIsolated=false.
manualOrLiveRequirements: Review hosted workflow permissions and secret availability before enabling pull-request automation.
Keep production credentials out of all untrusted test jobs.

controls.name: Provider API or SDK changes

evidence.locator: pinned provider and SDK contract register
evidence.claim: The supported Gemini, OpenAI-compatible and installed SDK interfaces are explicit and version pinned.

evidence.locator: offline provider and installed SDK compatibility check
evidence.claim: The checker verifies exact package locks and required installed interfaces without a production transport call.

evidence.locator: an intentional provider API contract change exits nonzero and names the blocked interface
evidence.claim: An unsupported API version or removed SDK method makes the compatibility pack fail safely before dispatch.

evidence.locator: server-owned provider response validators
evidence.claim: The production server and compatibility fixtures use the same strict request encoders and response validators for Gemini and OpenAI-compatible providers.

passCriteria.given: The supported pinned SDK and API fixtures are installed.
passCriteria.when: The compatibility pack runs.
passCriteria.then: Every required method, schema and response contract passes without contacting production.

passCriteria.given: A required method is removed or a provider schema or version becomes unsupported.
passCriteria.when: The same compatibility pack runs.
passCriteria.then: It exits nonzero, names the affected service and interface safely, and blocks release before production dispatch.

controls.remainingGap: The offline release gate is complete. Provider deprecation notices and any bounded staging check remain human release evidence and are not inferred from local compatibility.
manualOrLiveRequirements: Review provider deprecation notices before a release that changes an integration.
Use a bounded staging check only after local contract fixtures pass.

controls.name: Backup restore

evidence.locator: C12 restores scoped records, audit evidence and original private objects into clean isolated destinations
evidence.claim: One fictional tenant's exact records, structured tenant-bound audit rows and original object are manifested by identity, exact client path, byte length and SHA-256, then restored into clean isolated database and object destinations.

evidence.locator: a missing source object fails visibly before a backup can be claimed
evidence.claim: A missing original, tampered bundle or destination-altered object fails visibly before a verified restoration can be claimed.

evidence.locator: exact rows and objects restore, permissions hold, and the authorized app answer comes from the original
evidence.claim: Browser roles remain denied, cross-client access stops before object reading, and the authorized restored original produces the verified 400.00 THB answer with a new audit record.

evidence.locator: a post-restore record mismatch cleans both destinations and permits a retry
evidence.claim: A post-restore mismatch cleans and verifies both isolated destinations before a retry can succeed.

passCriteria.given: An isolated source contains scoped records, audit evidence and original private objects with recorded hashes.
passCriteria.when: Records and objects are exported and restored into clean isolated destinations.
passCriteria.then: Row identities, object paths, byte lengths and hashes match, and missing or tampered objects fail visibly.

passCriteria.given: The isolated restore completed.
passCriteria.when: Permission, tenant-isolation and application workflow checks run against the restored state.
passCriteria.then: Authorized access succeeds, cross-client access fails, and the application produces the verified answer from the restored original.

controls.remainingGap: The complete proof is isolated and fictional. It does not prove a production/full-project export, actual Supabase Storage adapter, private export security or a human-operated disaster-recovery exercise.
manualOrLiveRequirements: Define the private export location, encryption, access and retention policy without committing customer data.
Implement and review actual Supabase database and Storage export adapters before a human-owned recovery exercise in an approved test environment.
